doReMi.title: DO RE MI Game
doReMi.singNoteFor: Sing each note for {seconds} seconds to advance
doReMi.congratulationsMessage: You completed the {mode} scale holding each note for {seconds} seconds!

toneDetector.pageDescription: Detects multiple tones at once (C2–C7). Sing a harmony, hum several notes and see each tone displayed in real time.
toneDetector.sensitivityDescription: Controls how many tones are picked up. Lower it to filter out overtones when singing or playing a single note. Raise it to detect more simultaneous tones in a harmony or chord.
toneDetector.noiseGateDescription: Sets the minimum volume required to detect a tone. Raise it if you see false tones during silence. Lower it to pick up quieter sounds.
